{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Confirm the number of refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Inspect the revenue column: check for thousands separators
print('\nSample of revenue strings:')
print(sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any extreme values (e.g., 999999.99)
print('\nMax revenue value (float):', sales['revenue_float'].max())
print('Min revenue value (float):', sales['revenue_float'].min())

# Now, filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed}')"}
